params.1273: Kill Trolls in the cave north of Burthorpe.
params.1274: You can find trolls inhabiting the cave north of Burthorpe.
params.1275:
Kill 3 trolls in the cave.

There are different trolls in each of the cave's chambers.
params.1276:
Leave the cave.

If you want, you can kill some more trolls before leaving.
